tei:div.tei:p: (1)bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ dhī hūm̐/ chos rnams rang bzhin gdod nas rnam par dag ma rtogs 'gro la brtse ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyis/ rig pa'i hūm̐ las 'byung ba'i yi ge gsum/ me chu rlung gis ma dag gzung dang 'jin/ bsreg gtor bkrus nas chos nyid dbyings su sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las gnam sa gnam lcags kyi/ rnam gcod myur ba'i 'khor rtsibs bye ba/ spu gri so 'thab g.yas dang g.yon du 'khor/ ma gshin dregs pa'i dmag gis rab tu gtams/ me chu rlung gis bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i gur/ sred med bu yi stobs gyis mi bzlog pa/ de nang gnam lcags 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa/ steng du bdud rtsi thabs sbyor rnam pa bcu/ nang du zhal gzigs skyabs sbyin phyag rgyas bsrung*/ 'bar ba chen po sngags kyi sgra chen sgrog rtsibs mchan rnams su ma hā bā la bcu/ phyir gzigs ba tsan rlung g.yab phyar ba las/ bskal pa'i rlung nag rdo rje'i thog char gyis/ byugs dang mi kha dgra gyod jag rkun rnams/ dbang med bya sgro gzhob tu btang ba ltar/ rdul brlag lhag ma no'i pha mthar bsgrad/ de nang dbyangs kyi yi ge dkar po'i mig ka li dmar po'i 'phro 'du gur chen po/ de nas gser gyi tsakra rtsibs brgyad steng*/ mthu stobs dbang phyug phyag na rdo rje rnams/ nang du zhal gzigs bsrung ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ de nang rdo rje rwa gur me 'bar nang*/ gnam lcags las grub rdo rje rtse dgu pa/ yar rtse tshang gnas mar sne na rag gnas/ byad ma gan rgyal gnas pa'i lce snying 'dzar gser/ rdo rje'i lte bar rang bzhin gzhal yas khang*/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta bab rgyan (2)rdzogs dbus/ 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi rtsibs bcu nyis rim dbus/ chos 'byung chu glang pad nyi dgra bgegs steng*/ rang sems hūm̐ yig mthing nag 'phro 'dus las/ gdod ma'i dpal chen 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed/

mthing dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ g.yas gsum ral gri tho ba gtun shing dang*/ g.yon gsum lcags kyu sbrul zhags thogs gshol bsnams/ dur khrod dpal chas yongs rdzogs gar dgu'i nasam/ spyi mgrin snying ka lte ba gsang gnas su/ 'jam dpal rta mgrin gsang bdag chos kyi rgyal/ ser dmar mthing ljang be conasdig mjub can/ sang du gsang ba'i yab yum gcig bai tā li/ gri gug phur pa lcags dra bhandha'i phyag phyogs bzhi'i rtsibs steng rigs bzhi'i gshin rje gshed/ nang ma'i rtsibs bcur phyogs skyong gshin rje bcud/ phyi ma'irtsibs la bdud rtsi 'khyil ba bcu/ rtsibs mchan khro rgyal ma hā bā la bcud/ sga 'jin ging bdud rtsis shan bzhi bzhi'i tshogs/ gshinarje ma mo bdud btsan ma mgon zung*/ gza' klu gtsang ris rgyal chen phyogs skong tshogs/ kun kyang sna stong sgyu 'phrul rol pa'i gar/ rdo rje'i byin rlabs ye shes lnga dbang bskur/ dbyings nas dam tshig ye shes gnyis su med/ sngon tshe rgyal dang de sras thams cad kyi/ gang dag zhi ba'i thabs kyis ma thul ba/ ma rung zhing bcu ldan pa'i dgra dang bgegs/ khyed kyis mngon spyod las gyis tshar gcod mjod/ rang nyid 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed po yi/ thugs kar gsang bdag thugs dbus nyi ma'i steng*/ ya yig gdan thabs steng du hūm̐ mthing nag ha khog mig tu muṃ yig dmar ser mtshan/ de mthar sngags phreng (3)g.yas su 'khor ba las/ 'od zer dpag yas rnam gang bar 'phros/ rgyal ba rgyal sras khro rgyal mu mas mchod/ mthu stobs byin rlabs kun bsdus rang la bstim/ 'gro ba'i nyon mongs dgra bgegs thams cad btul/ bsod nams mthu nus kun bsdus bdag la thim/ bdag nid mthu stobs gzi brjid mtshungs med bsam/ oṃ hrīḥṣṭi wi tri twa na na hūm̐ phaṭaḥ zhes pa'i mtha' bskor du bsrung bya pho mo rnams mdun dang*/ nor rdzas g.yas/ yul mkhar g.yon/ phyug la sogs pa rgyab tu bsam/

de'i phyi rol du 'khor lo rtsibs bcu steng bdud rtsi 'khyil pa bcus skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgyas bsrung bya la bar du gcod pa'i mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod pa thams cad las skyob cing ma 'jigs pa sbyin pa dang*/ rtsibs mchan gyi khro bo rnams kyis phyir gzigs nas ralung g.yas g.yab pas god kha 'chi thal mi kha byad kha dgra kha 'dre dmag la sogs thams cad phye mar brlag par bsam la/ oṃ a ma king kang kha rlun nṛ myogs dgro wag st+wai bha ya nan/ bigna tri thuṃ te/ ti shan ti shan/ spur thum spur brub bi sha tsakra ha la ha la sa ma ya dgra sri st+waṃ bha ya rakṣa nan/ drun drun/ lam lam st+waṃ bha ya nan/ oṃ kha thuṃ kha thuṃ/ ya ma ya ma/ dun tri dun tri pra le dzwa le pra le dzwa le a mu ka'i ka wā tsi mā ra ya rbad nan/ chi sa shig kha thaṃ/

zhes dang*/ oṃ mi kha hur thum rbad/ dril dril/ thuṃ thuṃ/ shig shig bhyau/ bzlog bsgyur bsgyur/ zhes brjod bden stobs thal mo rdeb/ mthar ni dmigs med ngang la bzhag bsngo ba smon lam rgya yi gdab/ 'gyur med rdo rje'i bzheng skong du/ las kyi rdo rjes ngag gi dbang po'i padma las 'brel rtsal shal mar spel/ dge 'dis mtha' yas 'gro ba kun/ srid pa'i 'jigs pa las grol bar shog maṅga lam/// /
